chains.title: No TF-mediated allelic effect; linked causal variant or passenger
predictions: No allele-specific TF occupancy over rs339331 in prostate cells.
Ref and alt reporter constructs show similar activity in LNCaP.
RFX6 expression is not associated with rs339331 genotype after controlling for linked variants.
falsified_if: Allele-specific HOXB13 occupancy at rs339331 is reproducibly detected and the element shows HOXB13-dependent allele-specific reporter activity.

chains.title: HOXB13 binds ref T more, increasing RFX6 in prostate cells

links.claim: HOXB13 binds the ref T allele more strongly than alt C at rs339331. HOXB13 was chosen as a prostate-lineage TF with a literature-linked HOXB13/RFX6 mechanism at 6q22; no QBiC-SELEX evidence is provided, so this is not based on a QBiC-SELEX model.
rs339331 lies in a cis-regulatory enhancer element at 6q22; the ref allele preserves a stronger HOXB13 binding site.
Increased HOXB13 occupancy at this enhancer increases RFX6 transcription; this assumes HOXB13 acts as an activator at this element.
LNCaP prostate adenocarcinoma cells have prostate-lineage chromatin and express HOXB13/RFX6, making this element relevant in the DepMap LNCaP context.
Higher RFX6 expression in prostate epithelium increases prostate cancer risk or progression.

predictions: Ref T allele shows stronger HOXB13 occupancy than alt C at rs339331.
Ref reporter is more active than alt in LNCaP and this difference is reduced by HOXB13 knockdown.
RFX6 expression is higher with the ref allele.
falsified_if: No ref>alt HOXB13 occupancy is detected at rs339331, or the reporter/expression difference is not HOXB13-dependent.

chains.title: FOXA1 binds alt C more at the 6q22 element and alters RFX6

links.claim: FOXA1 binds the alt C allele more strongly than ref T at rs339331. FOXA1 was chosen as a prostate pioneer TF that can occupy prostate enhancers; no QBiC-SELEX evidence is provided.
rs339331 lies in a cis-regulatory enhancer element at 6q22; the alt allele creates a stronger FOXA1 binding site.
Increased FOXA1 occupancy at this enhancer increases RFX6 transcription or accessibility; this assumes FOXA1 acts as an activator at this element.
LNCaP prostate adenocarcinoma cells have FOXA1 and prostate-lineage chromatin, making this element relevant in the DepMap LNCaP context.
Higher RFX6 expression in prostate epithelium increases prostate cancer risk or progression.

predictions: Alt C allele shows stronger FOXA1 occupancy than ref T at rs339331.
Alt reporter is more active than ref in LNCaP and this difference is reduced by FOXA1 knockdown.
RFX6 expression is higher with the alt allele.
falsified_if: No FOXA1 occupancy is detected at rs339331, or the alt-specific reporter/expression effect is not FOXA1-dependent.

outcomes.outcome: no HOXB13 imbalance; FOXA1 alt > ref

next_experiment: Allele-specific HOXB13 ChIP-qPCR over rs339331 in LNCaP (or a heterozygous prostate cell line if LNCaP is homozygous). It is the cheapest direct separator: the null predicts no allelic HOXB13 imbalance, while the HOXB13-ref chain predicts ref T > alt C occupancy.
